summary.text: Johnny Baucom is the Libertarian candidate for Mississippi's 1st District. He describes himself as a Mississippian raised by a single mother who earned a GED through the National Guard Youth Challenge Program, served in the Army National Guard from 2014 to 2020, and later managed mechanic shops. Ballotpedia lists his profession as environmental specialist.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself as raised by a single mother in poverty, and says he left high school after ninth grade.
Says he earned his GED through the National Guard Youth Challenge Program at Camp Shelby in Hattiesburg.
Served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2014 to 2020 (a six-year contract, per his survey).
Says he used skills from the military to manage multiple mechanic shops; Ballotpedia lists his profession as environmental specialist.
